subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: John Keats, most studious and inspired artist among the romantics of 19th century, was born in London. He became an apprentice to a surgeon but he felt that the was born to be a poet. His narrative poem 'Endymon' received warm praise from his friends. He also published 'Hyperion and Other Poems'. He had seen a premature death.
